model.name: Strokes against the field
model.how: Each player's strokes better or worse than the field per round this season, newer rounds weighing more and stronger fields counting for more. The event is then played out 10,000 times to give the chance of a win, a top 10 and a top 20.
model.test: Scored on 31 events this season, each projected from the rounds before it: players given a 40% or better chance of a top 20 made it 49% of 271 times (expected 49%); error score 0.132 against 0.144 for giving every player the same chance (lower is better).
